label: Products
description: A Google tab on the product page

fields.label: Hide from Google
fields.hint: Turn on to keep this product out of Google Shopping and free listings. Products already in Google are removed within minutes.

fields.label: Brand
fields.hint: The brand of the product. Google requires it for most products; without it the product may be shown less or disapproved.

fields.label: Condition
fields.hint: Whether the product is new, used or refurbished. Empty means new.

fields.label: Google product category
fields.placeholder: e.g. 1604 or Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Shirts & Tops
fields.hint: Optional. Google picks a category itself from the title and description; set it only to correct Google. Paste a category number or full path from the Google product taxonomy (search the web for "Google product taxonomy").

fields.label: Age group
fields.hint: Only for clothing and accessories: the age group the product is for. Google requires it for them.

fields.label: Gender
fields.hint: Only for clothing and accessories: who the product is for. Google requires it for them.

fields.label: No barcode (GTIN) or part number (MPN)
fields.hint: Turn on for handmade, custom or vintage products that have no barcode and no manufacturer part number. Otherwise Google expects a GTIN or an MPN with the brand.

fields.label: Barcodes and part numbers
fields.hint: GTIN is the barcode number (UPC, EAN, ISBN). MPN is the manufacturer's part number. Give them per variant when the variants have their own.

fields.label: Google status
fields.hint: What Google says about this product right now.

fields.label: Shopping preview
fields.hint: How the product can look in Google Shopping, from the unsaved form.
